claim: Punctuates the boundary between scenes, and it defaults harder than a shot boundary does (fade_black rather than cut) because an audience needs to feel a location or time change, not just register it. Reach for match_cut when the two scenes rhyme and for smash when you want the change to hurt.
not_visual: Scene punctuation is an event spanning two scenes; its meaning is the relationship between the outgoing and incoming images, which no single frame contains. match_cut is the clearest case — it is defined entirely by shape agreement with a frame that does not exist in this panel — and time_card replaces the subject with a text card, which would violate the fixed-subject method outright and which Animagine renders as garbled glyphs anyway.
